STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_11431_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_11431_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_11431 (
    input        clk,
    input        reset,
    input  [31:2] pc_new,
    input        take_branch,
    input        pause_in,
    input  [25:0] opcode25_0,
    input  [ 1:0] pc_source,
    output [31:0] pc_out,
    output [31:0] pc_out_plus4,
    input        context_save,
    input        context_restore,
    input  [1:0] thread_id
);

    reg [31:2] pc_next0;
    reg [31:2] pc_next1;
    reg [31:2] pc_next2;
    reg [31:2] pc_next3;    
    reg [31:2] pc_next;
    reg [31:2] pc_reg;

    wire [31:2] pc_inc = pc_reg + 1; 
    wire [31:0] pc_out = {pc_reg, 2'b00};
    wire [31:0] pc_out_plus4 = {pc_inc, 2'b00};

    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset)
    begin
       if (reset)
          pc_reg <= 30'b0; // Adjust this constant according to `PC_RESET
       else
          pc_reg <= pc_next;
    end

    always @(pc_source or pc_inc or pc_reg or opcode25_0 or
             take_branch or pc_new or pause_in or reset or context_save or context_restore)
    begin
       case (pc_source)
          2'b00: pc_next = pc_inc; // Adjust these cases according to `from_inc4
          2'b01: pc_next = {pc_reg[31:28], opcode25_0}; // Adjust these cases according to `from_opcode25_0
          default: begin
             if (take_branch)  
                pc_next = pc_new;
             else
                pc_next = pc_inc;
          end
       endcase

       if (pause_in == 1'b1)
          pc_next = pc_reg;

       if(reset) begin
          pc_next0 = 30'b0;
          pc_next1 = 30'b0;
          pc_next2 = 30'b0;
          pc_next3 = 30'b0;
       end else begin
          case(thread_id)
             2'b00: begin
                if(context_save == 1'b1)
                    pc_next0 = pc_next;
                if(context_restore == 1'b1)
                    pc_next = pc_next0;
             end
             2'b01: begin
                if(context_save == 1'b1)
                    pc_next1 = pc_next;
                if(context_restore == 1'b1)
                    pc_next = pc_next1;
             end
             2'b10: begin
                if(context_save == 1'b1)
                    pc_next2 = pc_next;
                if(context_restore == 1'b1)
                    pc_next = pc_next2;
             end
             2'b11: begin
                if(context_save == 1'b1)
                    pc_next3 = pc_next;
                if(context_restore == 1'b1)
                    pc_next = pc_next3;
             end
          endcase
       end
    end

endmodule
